name: What are common challenges during backsplash installation in older Bay Area homes?

mainEntity.name: What are common challenges during backsplash installation in older Bay Area homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing backsplashes in older Bay Area homes, particularly in areas like San Bruno or South San Francisco, can present unique challenges. Walls may not be perfectly plumb or square due to settling over time, requiring additional preparation to create a flat, even surface for tile adhesion. Existing electrical outlets might need to be adjusted or extended to accommodate the new tile thickness. Older homes can also have outdated wiring or plaster walls, which require careful handling. Our experienced team at City Dweller, LLC is skilled in addressing these nuances, ensuring a smooth installation process that respects the unique characteristics of older properties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Older Bay Area homes may have uneven walls, outdated electrical, or plaster, requiring extra preparation for backsplash installation. Our team is experienced with these challenges.
